summary: The Mount Vernon Library Commons highlights the critical role of E-Rate in supporting libraries and schools in the community, emphasizing the cost and accessibility implications of its elimination. The Mount Vernon Library Commons receives E-Rate support at an 80 percent discount rate, reflecting that roughly four in five of its students are eligible for the National School Lunch Program. The comment argues that if E-Rate is eliminated or reduced, libraries and schools would be forced to reduce programs and services to continue providing internet access, as neighboring libraries and schools would be affected by a loss of capacity.
